newsitem.title: USA: Quantum to redeem 6-3/8 pct debentures.
newsitem.headline: Quantum to redeem 6-3/8 pct debentures.

text.p: Quantum Corp said it called for the redemption on Friday of its 6-3/8 percent convertible subordinated debentures due April 1, 2002.

The Milpitas, Calif.,-based company said the redemption date will be January 19. The redemption price will be $1,038.25 for each debenture, plus $19.13 of accrued interest from October 1, 1996 to the redemption date -- for a total of $1,057.38 for each $1,000 principal amount of debentures.
The debentures are convertible into common shares of Quantum at any time before 5 p.m., Chicago time on January 17, the trading day immediately preceding the redemption date.
The conversion rate is 55.10 shares of Quantum common shares for each $1,000 principal amount of debentures, which is equivalent to a conversion price of about $18.15 a share.

Quantum said it has arranged for Salomon Bros. Inc to purchase from it shares equivalent to the number that would have been issued on debentures not surrendered for conversion on or before 5 p.m., Chicago time, on January 17.

Under the standby arrangement, Salomon may also buy debentures in the open market on or before January 17, which the brokerage may convert into common stock. Salomon may make the conversion on or before January 17, Quantum said.

Quantum, a supplier of hard disk drives, separately filed on Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a registration statement for up to 5,110,690 common shares issuable upon conversion of the debentures.
According to the filing, Salomon's purchase price under the standy arrangement is $19.20 a share.
